title: Great app great value
body: Its everything i wanted and works flawlessly. Its approach to habit tracking helped me to see my progress in a more forgiving way letting me grow my habits. Ty for developing this app team
author: msrjaime

title: Great App to track
body: I love to track my habits with this app. Great widget too for each habit. The only thing I miss is see the accomplishment of my habit in a calendar graphic.
author: gheisenberg
